row.notes: Recordable interface of the sub-object at system+0x20 (this = system+0x20, so [this+0x10..+0x18] is the system's set list). For each set writes dword flags [set+0x30] then one byte ((rec+8 & 7) << 4 | rec+0 & 3) of the active input record; Game_ControllerSet_DeserialiseFlags (0x14389ceb0) reads it back. Flashback and replay frames carry the sets' flags and modes this way; this path does not free or rebuild sets.
